jobs.title: Senior Clinical Consultant, Pharmacy
jobs.description_html:
PSG (An EPIC owned company) is seeking a Sr. Clinical Consultant to provide consultative, clinically grounded guidance to payer clients in the rapidly evolving drug management market. This role combines deep clinical expertise with rigorous, data-driven analysis to shape clinical strategy, evaluate pharmacy and medical benefit programs, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations that improve outcomes and reduce total cost of care. An ideal candidate is a confident individual contributor and trusted advisor—detail oriented, highly collaborative, and able to translate complex clinical and financial information into executive-ready insights.


Key Responsibilities


•    Consultative Clinical Strategy: Partner with payer clients as a trusted clinical advisor to design and refine drug management strategies across benefits and channels (pharmacy and medical), informing PBM and coverage decisions with evidence-based, practical recommendations.
•    Vendor Clinical Program Evaluation: Assess and benchmark PBM and other industry vendor clinical programs (e.g., utilization management, specialty management, care management) using clinical evidence, operational feasibility, and performance data to inform optimization opportunities and client recommendations.
•    Data-Driven Clinical Insights: Leverage medical and pharmacy data to assess program performance, identify trend drivers and outliers (e.g., high-cost claims, site of care, utilization patterns), and translate findings into targeted clinical strategies and measurable recommendations.
•    Pipeline and Trend Advisory: Monitor emerging therapies, clinical guidelines, and market dynamics; model potential client impact and provide proactive, consultative guidance on readiness, coverage strategy, and program design.
•    Cross-Functional Delivery: Collaborate with analytics, consulting, and enterprise partners to develop clinically sound deliverables—linking data, evidence, and operational realities into clear client stories, recommendations, and implementation considerations.
•    Client Advisory Partnership: Build and maintain senior client relationships; serve as a highly visible subject matter expert who can facilitate discussions, pressure-test options, and guide decision-making with clinically credible, financially informed recommendations.
•    Thought Leadership: Strengthen PSG’s market presence by distilling complex clinical and industry trends into pragmatic points of view (e.g., blogs, client education, webinars, and speaking engagements) that help clients act on insights.

 

Location: Remote (US based)
 


Qualifications

•    Pharmacy degree required (RPh or PharmD)
•    MBA or other advanced business/healthcare degree a plus
•    5+ years of experience in a health plan/payer, PBM, specialty pharmacy, or consulting environment with responsibility for drug management strategy, clinical programs, and/or benefit design
•    5+ years of client-facing experience (account management, consulting, or clinical advisory) with a demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and present recommendations to senior leadership
•    Demonstrated expertise in specialty drug management (e.g., utilization management, site of care, biosimilars, formulary/coverage strategy, and clinical policy)
•    Medical benefit specialty drug experience strongly preferred (e.g., buy-and-bill, J-code management, prior authorization, site-of-care optimization)
•    Strong analytical skillset, including experience interpreting medical and pharmacy claims and translating results into clear, actionable clinical strategies and recommendations
•    Collaborative, team-first approach with the ability to partner effectively with analysts, consultants, and clinical stakeholders to deliver high-quality client work
•    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create executive-ready deliverables and clearly explain complex clinical and financial concepts
•    Ability to lead and facilitate client discussions, working sessions, and clinical reviews with internal and external stakeholders
•    Proven ability to build credibility quickly and maintain strong client relationships as a trusted clinical advisor
•    Strong presentation skills, including the ability to communicate data-driven clinical insights and recommendations to diverse audiences
•    Solutions-oriented and self-directed, with strong judgment and the ability to work through ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and deliver high-impact recommendations
•    Ability to operate effectively in a decentralized/remote work environment, managing time and deliverables with minimal oversight
•    Flexible for travel and client-facing activities (estimated 15%)

 

COMPENSATION:

 

The national average annual salary for this role is $140,000 – $180,000 in base pay and exclusive of any bonuses or benefits. The base pay offered will be determined based on your experience, skills, training, certifications and education, while also considering internal equity and market data.

 

WHY EPIC:

EPIC has over 60 offices and 3,000 employees nationwide – and we’re growing! It’s a great time to join the team and be a part of this growth. We offer:

  • Generous Paid Time off
    • Managed PTO for salaried/exempt employees (personal time off without accruals or caps); 22 PTO days starting out for hourly/non-exempt employees; 12 company-observed paid holidays; 4 early close days
  • Generous leave time options: Paid parental leave, pregnancy disability and bonding leave, and organ donor/bone marrow donor leave
  • Generous employee referral bonus program of $1,500 per hired referral
  • Quarterly employee recognition program for demonstrating EPIC’s values plus additional employee recognition awards and programs (and trips!)
  • Employee Resource Groups: Women’s Coalition, EPIC Veterans Group
  • Professional growth & development: Mentorship Program, Tuition Reimbursement Program, Leadership Development
  • Unique benefits such as Pet Insurance, Cancer Insurance, Identity Theft & Fraud Protection Coverage, Legal Planning, Family Planning, and Menopause & Midlife Support
  • Additional benefits include (but are not limited to): 401(k) matching, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, and wellness & employee assistance programs
  • 50/50 Work Culture: EPIC fosters a 50/50 culture between producers and the rest of the business, supporting collaboration, teamwork, and an inclusive work environment. It takes both production and service to be EPIC!
  • EPIC Gives Back – Some of our charitable efforts include Donation Connection, Employee Assistance Fund, and People First Foundation
  • We’re in the top 10 of property/casualty agencies according to “Insurance Journal”

 

To learn more about EPIC, visit our Careers Page: https://www.epicbrokers.com/about/epic-careers/. 

 

EPIC embraces diversity in all its various forms—whether it be diversity of thought, background, race, religion, gender, skills or experience. We are committed to fostering a work community where every colleague feels welcomed, valued, respected and heard. It is our belief that diversity drives innovation and that creating an environment where every employee feels included and empowered helps us to deliver the best outcome to our clients.

The EBI Analyst II – Pharmacy supports Enterprise Business Intelligence initiatives for Cleveland Clinic Pharmacy, with a focus on Specialty Pharmacy and broader operations. This role plays a critical part in ensuring medication access, regulatory compliance, and data-driven decision-making by delivering analytics for financial, operational, clinical, and research needs, including supporting drug distributor reporting tied to significant revenue. Working closely with pharmacists, pharmacy leadership, analytics teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, the analyst is responsible for extracting and analyzing large datasets, writing and optimizing SQL queries, and developing reports and dashboards. With a balanced workload of project-based and ad hoc requests, this position offers high visibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to translate complex data into actionable insights that directly impact patient care and pharmacy operations.

A caregiver in this position resides in Ohio, Florida or Nevada works days from 8:00AM – 5:00PM.

You could be the one who changes everything for our 28 million members as a clinical professional on our Medical Management/Health Services team. Centene is a diversified, national organization offering competitive benefits including a fresh perspective on workplace flexibility.
 

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, or CPT.

This is a hybrid role with 50% travel required to local pharmacies. Qualified candidates must reside in New York.

Position Purpose: The Pharmacy Quality Performance Manager will partner with health plans to drive pharmacy performance with an emphasis on pharmacy quality measures. Cross discipline interfacing across internal teams and external provider group partners to accelerate pharmacy quality.

  • Provide expertise in enterprise pharmacy quality initiatives

  • Subject matter expert on pharmacy quality measures across LOBs (Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace)

  • Provide clinical and quality expertise to health plans and provider partners

  • Develop and present performance reviews in tandem with provider facing teams to address pharmacy chapter quality performance across: members, providers, provider groups, H-Contract and States

  • Strategize and coordinate between market and enterprise pharmacy chapter measure initiatives to ensure complimentary efforts

  • Identify areas of opportunity for internal teams’ and external provider partners’ operations to accelerate pharmacy measure performance

  • Facilitate communication, understanding and training around enterprise pharmacy quality initiatives to internal provider facing teams to extend the reach of quality performance impact

  • Performs other duties as assigned

  • Complies with all policies and standards

3+ years of retail or hospital pharmacy experience or 1+ years of managed care pharmacy experience required
